quickStart.title: Quick Start Guide
quickStart.description: Get started with FERVIX in just a few simple steps. Our advanced medical device technology ensures safe and effective treatment.

manual.title: User Manual
manual.description: Complete instructions for using your FERVIX device safely and effectively.
manual.step1: Connect your device to the USB-C port and wait for detection
manual.step2: Select your treatment profile based on your needs and skin type
manual.step3: Follow the on-screen instructions for proper device positioning
manual.step4: Complete the treatment cycle and allow proper cooling time

important.title: Important Information
important.description: Essential safety information and usage guidelines for optimal results.
important.warning1: Always consult with your healthcare provider before starting treatment
important.warning2: Do not use on broken, irritated, or infected skin
important.warning3: Discontinue use immediately if you experience any adverse reactions
